mechanism: Infliximab may increase methotrexate toxicity risk, and folic acid supplementation is used to mitigate methotrexate-induced folate depletion when these drugs are co-administered.
action: Folic acid supplementation (1mg daily or 5mg weekly) is recommended to reduce methotrexate toxicity when used concurrently with infliximab; this is a beneficial combination rather than a contraindication.
